About

My educational background and areas of work.

I completed a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering Education at Universitas Negeri Yogyakarta with a 3.69 GPA and Cum Laude honours. The programme combines mechanical engineering subjects (design and CAD, machining, welding, casting, industrial metrology, pneumatic and hydraulic systems, machine maintenance and repair) with teaching subjects. I carried out the teaching side at SMK Negeri 1 Magelang: one semester of manufacturing technical drawing and AutoCAD 2D for three grade-XI classes, 105 students. My industrial placement was with Process Engineering at PT Astra Honda Motor, Karawang, covering preventive maintenance and troubleshooting of production equipment, and the redesign of a steel ball launcher used in the steering assembly process. For my final thesis I designed and built a QR-based workshop asset management system, now registered as intellectual property.

Projects

What I designed, built and wrote.

Steel Ball Launcher Redesign

Industrial placement project · 2026

The existing pneumatic launcher leaked at the seal, ran on inconsistent air pressure and occasionally misfired without operator input. I replaced the whole actuation principle with a compression spring and trigger: 312.5 N/m spring constant, 1.2 mm wire, 8 active coils, producing 5 N of thrust over a 16 mm stroke. The housing and interfaces of the old tool were kept deliberately, so the design drops into the existing line without modification. The work stopped at the design stage: it has not been prototyped or trialled on the line, so the figures above are calculated, not measured.

Machine elementsSolidWorksRoot cause analysis

Spring Mechanism: Section View

Detail of the launcher redesign

Comparison of the pneumatic and spring systems across stability, maintenance demand and failure risk. The spring version removes the compressed-air dependency entirely, which is where every one of the original failures started. The design was recommended for prototyping and testing.

Technical drawingDesign comparison

SIMASET: QR Code Asset Management System

Undergraduate thesis · 2025-2026

A web application I built end to end for laboratory and workshop asset management: automatic QR labelling, borrowing and returns, material requests, damage reports, and maintenance logging with costs. Reports filter and export to Excel, CSV, PDF and the Indonesian KIB A/B/C government asset formats, across six user permission levels. Built as a JavaScript single-page application on Firebase. The system and its user manual are both registered intellectual property.

Open the live system: dptm.simaset.online
JavaScriptFirebaseAsset managementRegistered IP

SIMASET: Asset Registration & QR Labelling

Detail of the thesis system

Every registered asset generates its own QR label, so a technician can scan a machine and reach its maintenance history, cost record and current borrower without going through a paper ledger. This was the part of the system the workshop staff actually cared about.
